findings_summary: Live fill-rate check on Inner West (n=40): DevelopmentType 39/40 (nested list of {DevelopmentType:...}), CostOfDevelopment 40/40 (float), NumberOfNewDwellings 16/40, CouncilApplicationNumber 20/40 (e.g. DA/2026/0548), AssessmentExhibitionEndDate 4/40 (ISO w/ T00:00:00 — set only during objection window, the actionable field). DeterminationAuthority often 'Unknown' -> skip. No new queries; presentation-only change to build_alert_email; all values verbatim/null-guarded.
